## Outcome

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Include the issue's acceptance
criteria that this change satisfies.

## Related issue

<!-- For completed work, replace the placeholder with e.g. Closes #3.
     For partial work, use Refs #3 instead. -->

Closes #<issue-number>

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results. Note skipped checks and why.
If the test runner found zero tests, say so. Include device testing for mobile
changes when applicable; use synthetic data in any screenshots.

## Security and privacy impact

Describe changes to authentication, ownership, permissions, secrets, logging,
imports, dependencies, or data handling. Write "None" with a brief reason if
there is no impact. Report vulnerability details privately using SECURITY.md.

## Review

- [ ] I reviewed the final diff and staged only intended files.
- [ ] No credentials, real financial data, or sensitive logs are included.
- [ ] Relevant acceptance criteria, validation, and limitations are documented.
- [ ] Destructive operations or migrations have clear warnings if applicable.
